It is found that the higher the degree of information cocoon, the greater the common emotional bias between different information cocoon rooms. Among 32 kinds of emotions, the proportion of surprise, helplessness, peace of mind, miss, envy, joy, excitement, guilt and pride can be used to predict the degree of information loss of users, and the adjusted R square reaches 0.489. On the basis of this emotional bias, as the degree of user information cocoon deepens, user emotion and the “top” user of information cocoon are more and more similar.
